title: NFL business partners aren't pulling punches as to the handling of Jalen Hurts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL business partners aren't pulling punches as to the handling of Jalen Hurts
sources.description: The Eagles' handling of quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot in Week 5 has sparked plenty of criticism of both the team and the league, which has been in lockstep with the team.
